action_summary: Kept the v54 EEGNet checkpoints, transforms and TTA unchanged. Changed the aggregation so each TTA view of each fold model is first converted to a normalized distribution (sigmoid then row-normalize), and these distributions are averaged across views and models, instead of averaging raw logits and applying a single sigmoid. A mixture of distributions is less over-confident than sigmoid(mean logits), which matters for the KL divergence metric. Added a small probability floor (1e-3) followed by renormalization before writing submission.csv to avoid KL blow-up on classes that receive some expert votes but a near-zero prediction. Both behaviours are controlled by flags (probability_averaging, probability_floor) so the previous logit-averaging path can be restored with one switch.
